mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% correlates with negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% over three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeding 4.0% coincides with positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST and RSAFS declines produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing slowdown that precedes earnings revisions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansions do not yield negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 6.0% signals persistent price pressures that trigger aggressive Fed tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY correlates with positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases correlate with negative 5-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market weakening that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise produce positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate increases above 2.0% signal aggressive policy that raises equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases above 2.0% during tightening cycles do not yield negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
